rule.rvol_baseline: strictly prior 90 sessions at the same minute-from-open

selection_policy: One frozen rule from EXP-0015; no threshold search
success_rule: Full-sample net R and daily Sharpe improve, at least 90% of trades remain, and paired Null-C net-R uplift z >= 2
weakener: Net-R uplift is not positive in both pre-2023 and 2023+ eras
